ei.title: 2번: A Lesson from the Irish Famine
ei.subject: 빠른독해바른독해_구문독해_2024

fullPassage: In the 1800s, the people of Ireland used potatoes as their basic food source. Unfortunately, everyone was growing the same type of potato, which meant the crops all had the same genes. The farmers did not realize the danger in this. In the 1840s, a new potato disease struck. The genetically identical potatoes all lacked the ability to fight the disease, so they all rotted. Because people were dependent mainly on potatoes for their food, Ireland suffered a famine in which one in eight people died during the following years. If people had grown many types of potatoes, they could have identified resistant ones and grown more of them, making the famine less serious. Despite knowing this, many countries today take the same risk with their crops.

questions.passage: In the 1800s, the people of Ireland used potatoes as their (A)[basic / rare] food source. Unfortunately, everyone was growing the same type of potato, which meant the crops all had the same genes. The farmers did not realize the danger in this. In the 1840s, a new potato disease struck. The genetically identical potatoes all (B)[had / lacked] the ability to fight the disease, so they all rotted. Because people were dependent mainly on potatoes for their food, Ireland suffered a famine in which one in eight people died during the following years. If people had grown many types of potatoes, they could have identified (C)[weak / resistant] ones and grown more of them, making the famine less serious. Despite knowing this, many countries today take the same risk with their crops.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) basic=기본적인 / rare=드문 (B) lacked=~이 없었다 / had=가졌다 (C) resistant=저항력 있는 / weak=약한
det.analysis:
① rare—lacked—resistant: (A) 감자는 드문 식량이 아니라 '기본(basic)' 식량
② basic—lacked—resistant: 기본 식량 + 병과 싸울 능력이 없음 + 저항력 있는 품종 ←정답
③ basic—had—weak: (B)(C) 똑같은 유전자라 병과 싸울 능력이 '없었고(lacked)', 살아남으려면 '저항력 있는(resistant)' 품종이 필요
④ rare—had—weak: (A)(B)(C) 모두 문맥과 반대
det.tip: 감자는 basic(기본) 식량, 똑같은 유전자라 병에 맞설 능력이 lacked(없음), 살길은 resistant(저항력 있는) 품종

questions.passage: In the 1800s, the people of Ireland used potatoes as their basic food source. Unfortunately, everyone was growing the same type of potato, which meant the crops all had the same genes. The farmers did not realize the danger in this. In the 1840s, a new potato disease struck. The genetically (A)[identical / different] potatoes all lacked the ability to fight the disease, so they all rotted. Because people were (B)[independent / dependent] mainly on potatoes for their food, Ireland suffered a famine in which one in eight people died during the following years. If people had grown many types of potatoes, they could have identified resistant ones and grown more of them, making the famine less serious. Despite knowing this, many countries today take the same (C)[benefit / risk] with their crops.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) identical=동일한 / different=다른 (B) dependent=의존하는 / independent=독립적인 (C) risk=위험 / benefit=이익
det.analysis:
① identical—dependent—risk: 유전적으로 동일 + 감자에 의존 + 같은 위험을 감수 ←정답
② different—dependent—benefit: (A)(C) 감자가 유전적으로 '달랐다'면 다 죽지 않았을 것, 오늘날 국가들은 '이익'이 아니라 위험을 감수
③ identical—independent—benefit: (B)(C) 사람들은 감자에 '독립적'인 게 아니라 의존했고, 감수하는 건 위험
④ different—independent—risk: (A)(B) 문맥과 반대
det.tip: 유전적으로 identical(동일), 감자에 dependent(의존), 오늘날도 같은 risk(위험) 감수

questions.passage: In the 1800s, the people of Ireland used potatoes as their basic food source. Unfortunately, everyone was growing the same type of potato, which meant the crops all had the same genes. The farmers did not (A)[realize / ignore] the danger in this. In the 1840s, a new potato disease struck. The genetically identical potatoes all lacked the ability to fight the disease, so they all (B)[survived / rotted]. Because people were dependent mainly on potatoes for their food, Ireland suffered a famine in which one in eight people died during the following years. If people had grown many types of potatoes, they could have identified resistant ones and grown more of them, making the famine less (C)[famous / serious]. Despite knowing this, many countries today take the same risk with their crops.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) realize=깨닫다 / ignore=무시하다 (B) rotted=썩었다 / survived=살아남았다 (C) serious=심각한 / famous=유명한
det.analysis:
① ignore—rotted—serious: (A) 농부들은 위험을 '무시하지 않았다'가 아니라 '깨닫지(realize) 못했다'
② realize—survived—famous: (B)(C) 감자는 살아남은 게 아니라 썩었고, 기근을 덜 '유명하게'가 아니라 덜 '심각하게'
③ realize—rotted—serious: 위험을 깨닫지 못함 + 감자가 썩음 + 기근을 덜 심각하게 ←정답
④ ignore—survived—famous: (A)(B)(C) 모두 문맥과 반대
det.tip: 농부들이 위험을 realize(깨달음) 못함, 감자가 rotted(썩음), 기근이 덜 serious(심각)

questions.passage: In the 1800s, the people of Ireland used potatoes as their ①<u>basic</u> food source. Unfortunately, everyone was growing the same type of potato, which meant the crops all had the same genes. The farmers did not realize the ②<u>danger</u> in this. In the 1840s, a new potato disease ③<u>struck</u>. The genetically identical potatoes all lacked the ability to fight the disease, so they all rotted. Because people were dependent mainly on potatoes for their food, Ireland suffered a famine in which one in eight people died during the following years. If people had grown many types of potatoes, they could have identified resistant ones and grown more of them, making the famine less serious. Despite knowing this, many countries today take the same ④<u>benefit</u> with their crops.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ① basic=기본적인 ② danger=위험 ③ struck=덮쳤다 ④ risk→benefit (부적절)
det.analysis:
① basic: 감자를 기본 식량으로 삼았다 — 적절
② danger: 농부들은 그 위험을 깨닫지 못했다 — 적절
③ struck: 새로운 감자 병이 덮쳤다 — 적절
④ benefit: 오늘날 많은 나라가 같은 '이익'을 감수한다? 과거의 실수를 되풀이한다는 흐름이므로 같은 '위험(risk)'을 감수가 원문 ←정답
det.tip: 과거 실수를 되풀이 = 같은 risk(위험) 감수. benefit(이익)은 정반대

questions.passage: In the 1800s, the people of Ireland used potatoes as their basic food source. ①<u>Luckily</u>, everyone was growing the same type of potato, which meant the crops all had the same genes. The farmers did not ②<u>realize</u> the danger in this. In the 1840s, a new potato disease struck. The genetically identical potatoes all lacked the ability to fight the disease, so they all rotted. Because people were ③<u>dependent</u> mainly on potatoes for their food, Ireland suffered a famine in which one in eight people died during the following years. If people had grown many types of potatoes, they could have identified ④<u>resistant</u> ones and grown more of them, making the famine less serious. Despite knowing this, many countries today take the same risk with their crops.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: 밑줄 친 ①은 Luckily(다행히도)가 아니라 Unfortunately(불행히도)가 되어야 한다. 나머지 realize, dependent, resistant는 문맥상 적절하다.
det.analysis:
① Luckily: '다행히도' 모두가 같은 품종을 길렀다? 이것이 재앙으로 이어졌으므로 '불행히도(Unfortunately)'가 원문 ←정답
② realize: 농부들은 위험을 깨닫지 못했다 — 적절
③ dependent: 사람들이 감자에 의존했다 — 적절
④ resistant: 저항력 있는 품종을 찾았을 것이다 — 적절
det.tip: 같은 품종만 기른 것이 재앙의 원인 → Unfortunately(불행히도). Luckily(다행히)는 정반대

questions.passage: In the 1800s, the people of Ireland used potatoes as their basic food source. In the 1840s, a new potato disease ②<u>struck</u>. The genetically identical potatoes all ③<u>gained</u> the ability to fight the disease, so they all rotted. Because people were dependent mainly on potatoes for their food, Ireland ④<u>suffered</u> a famine in which one in eight people died during the following years. If people had grown many types of potatoes, they could have identified resistant ones and grown more of them, making the famine less serious. Despite knowing this, many countries today take the same risk with their crops.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ① genes=유전자 ② struck=덮쳤다 ③ lacked→gained (부적절) ④ suffered=겪었다
det.analysis:
① genes: 작물이 모두 같은 유전자를 가졌다 — 적절
② struck: 새로운 병이 덮쳤다 — 적절
③ gained: 감자가 병과 싸울 능력을 '얻었다'? 그렇다면 썩지 않았을 텐데 뒤에 '모두 썩었다'가 이어지므로 능력이 '없었다(lacked)'가 원문 ←정답
④ suffered: 아일랜드가 기근을 겪었다 — 적절
det.tip: 능력을 gained(얻음)했다면 썩지 않음. 뒤에 '썩었다'가 오므로 lacked(없었다)가 맞음

det.korean: reason=이유 / ability=능력 / habit=습관 / permission=허락
det.analysis:
① reason: 병과 싸울 '이유'가 없어서 썩었다? 문맥은 능력의 문제
② ability: 똑같은 유전자라 병과 싸울 능력이 없어 모두 썩음 ←정답
③ habit: 병과 싸울 '습관'? 어색함
④ permission: 병과 싸울 '허락'? 문맥 무관

questions.stem: 다음 (A)와 (B)에서 밑줄 친 type의 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.tip: type의 다의어: 같은 종류(명사) vs 타자를 치다(동사)

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "a serious lack of food over a long period of time in a region, causing many people to suffer or die"

det.korean: harvest=수확 / climate=기후 / tradition=전통 / famine=기근
det.analysis:
① harvest: 수확 — 곡물을 거두는 일이지 식량 부족이 아님
② climate: 기후 — 날씨 상태
③ tradition: 전통 — 관습
④ famine: 기근 — 오랜 기간 심각한 식량 부족으로 많은 사람이 고통받거나 죽는 것 ←정답
det.tip: serious lack of food + many people die = 기근(famine)

questions.passage: Unfortunately, everyone was __________ (grow) the same type of potato, which meant the crops all had the same genes. The farmers did not realize the danger in this.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: grow(동사: 기르다) → growing (be동사 was 뒤 과거진행형)
det.analysis: be동사 was 뒤에서 '~하고 있었다'라는 과거진행을 나타내려면 동사에 -ing를 붙여요. 즉 grow를 growing으로 바꿔 was growing(기르고 있었다)을 만들어요.
det.tip: was + 동사원형-ing = 과거진행 → was growing

questions.passage: If people had grown many types of potatoes, they could have identified resistant ones and grown more of them, __________ (make) the famine less serious.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: make(동사: 만들다) → making (분사구문). 콤마 뒤에서 앞 내용을 부연하며 '그래서 ~하게 만들면서'를 나타내는 현재분사
det.analysis: 콤마 뒤에서 '그래서 (결과적으로) ~하게 만들며'라는 뜻으로 앞 문장 전체를 부연하는 분사구문이에요. and it would make ... → 접속사·주어를 지우고 동사를 현재분사로 바꿔 making으로 써요.
det.tip: 콤마 뒤 부연 분사구문 → 현재분사 making

questions.passage: In the 1800s, the people of Ireland used potatoes as their basic food source. Unfortunately, everyone was growing the same type of potato, which meant the crops all had the same genes. The farmers did not realize the danger in this. In the 1840s, a new potato disease struck. The genetically identical potatoes all lacked the ability to fight the disease, so they all rotted. Because people were dependent mainly on potatoes for their food, Ireland suffered a famine in which one in eight people died during the following years. If people had grown __________, they could have identified resistant ones and grown more of them, making the famine less serious. Despite knowing this, many countries today take the same risk with their crops.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: many types of potatoes=여러 종류의 감자 / a single small farm=하나의 작은 농장 / their own food source=자신들의 식량원 / some foreign crops=몇몇 외국 작물
det.analysis:
① many types of potatoes: 여러 종류를 길렀다면 그중 저항력 있는 품종을 찾을 수 있었을 것 ←정답
② a single small farm: 하나의 작은 농장? 다양성과 무관
③ their own food source: 자신들의 식량원? 뒤의 '저항력 있는 품종을 찾다'와 연결 약함
④ some foreign crops: 외국 작물? 감자 품종 다양성이 핵심
det.tip: If people had grown __________ + 저항력 있는 품종을 찾음 → 여러 종류의 감자(다양성)

questions.passage: In the 1800s, the people of Ireland used potatoes as their basic food source. Unfortunately, everyone was growing the same type of potato, which meant the crops all had the same genes. The farmers did not realize the danger in this. In the 1840s, a new potato disease struck. The genetically identical potatoes all lacked the ability to fight the disease, so they all rotted. Because people were dependent mainly on potatoes for their food, Ireland suffered a famine in which one in eight people died during the following years. If people had grown many types of potatoes, they could have identified resistant ones and grown more of them, making the famine less serious. Despite knowing this, many countries today take __________ with their crops.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: great pride=큰 자부심 / the same risk=같은 위험 / special care=특별한 관리 / a long break=긴 휴식
det.analysis:
① great pride: 큰 자부심을 감수한다? 문맥 무관
② the same risk: 그것을 알면서도 오늘날 많은 나라가 (과거 아일랜드와) 같은 위험을 감수함 ←정답
③ special care: 특별한 관리? '위험을 감수한다'는 흐름과 반대
④ a long break: 긴 휴식? 작물과 무관
det.tip: Despite knowing this + take __________ with their crops → 같은 실수를 되풀이 = 같은 위험(the same risk)
